attacks.name: Nova Burst
steps: After this attack is resolved, this character gains 1 |!power|.
|!wild| |*Throw|: After this attack is resolved, if the defender is |!size| 4 or less, this character may Throw it Away |!movement_small|.

attacks.name: Gravimetric Cannon
steps: After this attack is resolved, this character gains 1 |!power|.
|*Push|: If this attack deals |!damage|, after this attack is resolved, this character Pushes the defender Away |!movement_small|.
|!wild| |!block| |*Judgment|: After this attack is resolved, the defender gains the |§judgment§Judgment| special condition.

attacks.name: Lightspeed Lance
steps: After all attacks generated by this attack are resolved, Place this character within |!range| 1 of the last character targeted by this attack.
|!wild| |*Push|: After each attack is resolved, this character Pushes the defender Away |!movement_small|.

superPowers.name: Faster Than Light
superPowers.body: |*Action|: This character makes an attack action. After the attack is resolved, Place this character within |!range| 2 of itself. This superpower can be used only once per Turn.

superPowers.name: Xandarian Worldmind
superPowers.body: When this character or an allied character within |!range| 3 makes a defense or dodge roll, during the |*Modify Dice| step, this character may spend up to 3 |!power| to use this superpower. For each |!power| spent, the allied character may reroll 1 of its defense or dodge dice. This superpower can be used only once per Turn.

superPowers.name: Nova Force
superPowers.body: After this character makes a move action during its Activation, after the effect is resolved, it gains 2 |!power| and may remove all special conditions from itself. Add 3 dice to the next attack roll made as part of a |*Nova Burst| or |*Lightspeed Lance| attack made by this character this Activation. This character can be affected by this superpower only once per Turn.
